sentence: My father is a ___ . He drives a truck.
explanation: DRIVE → driver (se agrega -r a los verbos terminados en -e para formar un sustantivo de persona)

sentence: She is a good ___ . She teaches English.
explanation: TEACH → teacher (add -er to make a person who teaches)

sentence: He is a famous ___ . He sings beautiful songs.
explanation: SING → singer (add -er to make a person who sings)

sentence: The ___ painted a beautiful picture.
explanation: PAINT → painter (add -er to make a person who paints)

sentence: My mother is a ___ . She works in a bank.
explanation: BANK → banker (add -er to make a person who works in a bank)

sentence: The ___ fixed the broken pipe.
explanation: PLUMB → plumber (se agrega -er para formar la persona que trabaja con tuberías)

sentence: She wants to be a ___ when she grows up. She loves to dance.
explanation: DANCE → dancer (add -r to verbs ending in -e)

sentence: The ___ writes stories for the newspaper.
explanation: WRITE → writer (add -r to verbs ending in -e)

sentence: He is a fast ___ . He runs every morning.
explanation: RUN → runner (se duplica la consonante final y se agrega -er)

sentence: The ___ swims in the pool every day.
explanation: SWIM → swimmer (se duplica la consonante final y se agrega -er)

sentence: My uncle is an ___ . He acts in movies.
explanation: ACT → actor (add -or to make a person who acts)

sentence: The ___ visited our school to check our eyes.
explanation: VISIT → visitor (add -or to make a person who visits)

sentence: She is the ___ of the school. She manages everything.
explanation: DIRECT → director (add -or to make a person who directs)

sentence: The ___ invented a new machine.
explanation: INVENT → inventor (add -or to make a person who invents)

sentence: He is a good ___ . He plays football very well.
explanation: PLAY → player (add -er to make a person who plays)

sentence: The ___ cleaned the office after work.
explanation: CLEAN → cleaner (add -er to make a person who cleans)

sentence: My sister is a ___ . She bakes cakes and bread.
explanation: BAKE → baker (add -r to verbs ending in -e)

sentence: The ___ helped us find our way in the museum.
explanation: GUIDE puede ser tanto verbo como sustantivo — la persona que guía también se llama guide.

sentence: He is a ___ . He farms vegetables and fruits.
explanation: FARM → farmer (add -er to make a person who farms)

sentence: The ___ designed a beautiful building.
explanation: DESIGN → designer (add -er to make a person who designs)
